text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente put on a magnificent run. Yet, 
her expression was troubled, for she had 
failed to control and pace herself.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
She says she wants to run in a way she 
truly believes is the strongest and win 
the Classic races. If so, it's the 
Trainer's job to figure out how.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
So, they asked Air Groove, who knew her 
well, for input. Air Groove shared a story 
from when they were young.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
They say that back in the day, when 
Duramente got too worked up, her father 
yelled her name at the top of his lungs. 
That brought her back to her senses, and 
she went on to win.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
—Let's try the same method. I will 
definitely make my voice reach Duramente. 
At the upcoming Satsuki Sho.
